title: Dune Jet Ski Rental of Key West
specs: Premium, top-of-the-line jet skis with full tank of gas
Expert licensed local guides familiar with Key West shoreline
Scenic routes including coral reefs, mangroves, and landmarks
Must be 18 or older to rent or operate a jet ski
Passengers can ride from age 6 and up, depending on weight and weather conditions
Florida law requires Boater’s Safety Certificate if born after January 1, 1988; temporary online test provided
Valid photo ID required (driver’s license or passport)
Jet skis are beginner-friendly; no previous experience required
Two adults or one adult and one child can ride on the same jet ski, subject to weight and safety limits (around 400 lbs / 180 kg)
includes: Life jackets and safety gear included
blurb: Guests rent premium jet skis and take guided tours around Key West, exploring the harbor, coastline, and local sandbars. Tours include safety briefings and instruction for beginners. Stops for swimming and photo opportunities are included depending on conditions.
extraNote: Tours may be rescheduled or refunded if weather conditions are unsafe · Walk-ins allowed but not guaranteed; advance booking recommended · Small state fee may apply for temporary boating license · Dockside location near Historic Seaport, Key West
